criterion: Coefficient direction and unit basis are frozen
why_it_matters: A coefficient cannot be promoted if sign or direction conventions are mixed
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states the direction convention and unit basis for the row
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms one direction convention and one unit basis
fail_or_defer_condition: If sign direction or units remain mixed then defer
notes: Strong conversion coefficients are reviewable only after convention clarity.

criterion: Source support is strong enough for the claimed use
why_it_matters: Route-average or vendor-context coefficients can be misused as site truth
required_evidence_or_check: Check source cards evidence labels and claimed modelling role
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms the evidence is strong enough or limits the use
fail_or_defer_condition: If evidence is weak overstated or untraceable then defer
notes: Source labels must distinguish public vendor academic and assumption-only support.

why_it_matters: Small coefficient shifts can move feasibility and route economics
required_evidence_or_check: Check whether uncertainty is explicitly carried into the packet
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms sensitivity-required treatment where needed
fail_or_defer_condition: If uncertain coefficients are proposed as unconditional base values then fail
notes: Conversion coefficients should be reviewed before high-risk capacities but not auto-approved.
